Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout

package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout
Layout of a DOT graph with Smetana, and its result as plain geometry.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot
    Diagrams written in the DOT language (@startdot), parsed by PlantUML, laid out by Smetana (the Java port of Graphviz) and drawn with UGraphic, without the Graphviz executable.
    net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.attr
    Typed reading of DOT attribute values.
    net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.draw
    Drawing of a laid out DOT graph with UGraphic.
    net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model
    The parsed DOT graph: subgraphs, nodes, edges and their attributes, following the semantics of Graphviz.
    net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.parser
    Lexer and recursive descent parser of the DOT language.
  • Class
    Description
    LayoutInput
    What the drawing side tells the layout: Smetana does not measure text, so the size of every node and label is computed beforehand by PlantUML.
    LayoutInput.Outline
    The outline used by Smetana to clip the edges at a node.
    LayoutResult
    The geometry computed by Smetana, copied into plain Java objects so that the drawing does not depend on Smetana any more.
    LayoutResult.ClusterBox
    A cluster: its bounding box and the center of its label.
    LayoutResult.EdgeRoute
    An edge: a piecewise cubic Bezier curve (1 + 3n points), the tips of its arrows when it has some, and the center of its label.
    LayoutResult.NodeBox
    A node: its center and its size.
    NodeContour
    The real outline of a node whose shape Smetana does not know.
    Rankdir
    The rankdir graph attribute.
    SmetanaLayout
    Lays out a DotGraph with Smetana.
